$comment: HIMMEL-2302: per-cadence wizard registry — one row per cadence UNIT (script-level granularity) the install wizard can offer to arm. bin.js's askCadences()/CADENCE_REGISTRY enumerate from this file; the menu is never a hardcoded list in bin.js. `script` is a repo-root-relative path to a cmd_arm()/cmd_status()/cmd_disarm() cadence script (test-wizard-cadence-registry.sh's staleness lint asserts both facts for every row). `requires`: 'vault' rows are only offered when vault!=='none'; 'lane:codex' rows are only offered when 'codex' is in the final lanes selection (filtered out otherwise, so the answer stays genuinely undefined — never fabricated). `recommended` is a static per-row signal (today: only pipeline) — the wizard's actual per-run pre-selected default comes from PROFILE_PRESETS[profile].cadenceIds in bin.js, not from this flag. scripts/graphify/ggs-cadence.sh is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this registry — it is operator-personal hardware (a Spider Farmer GGS BLE controller cadence), not a general installer surface.
